title: N-ary tree preorder
summary: Build nodes with independent child lists. Visit each parent before its children, preserving sibling order with an explicit stack.
code: stack = [] if root is None else [root]
triggers: each node may have any number of children
preserve sibling order in a preorder traversal
prompts: Print folders in outline order, with each folder followed by its contents.
Walk a menu hierarchy in display order, visiting each heading before its entries.
invariant: The next node to visit is on top of the stack.
mantra: Push siblings in reverse display order.
pitfalls: Give every node its own child list to avoid sharing children between unrelated nodes.

anchors.name: N-ary Tree Preorder Traversal
anchors.trick: Reverse the children on push to visit the first child next.

mutations.explanation: The last sibling would be visited first.

test: root = Node('A', Node('B', Node('D')), Node('C'), Node('E'))
